actions.planHelp: Dry-run the sample grid first, review the planned dataset id, then build. Safer for new windows.
actions.buildHelp: Skip dry-run and materialize immediately. The backend mints a new dataset id.

plan.title: Plan training dataset
plan.summary: Dry-run the sample grid; no artifact or ledger row is written.
plan.reviewSummary: Review the dry-run result, then build reusing this dataset id.

build.title: Build training dataset
build.summary: Plan and materialize the PIT dataset (may take minutes).

selector.prefillOrphan: Dataset {id} is no longer trainable; select another.

form.summary: Pick a frozen runtime-config version and a model spec, then bound the PIT window.
form.horizonsHelp: Comma-separated positive integers (one label column per horizon).
form.incomplete: Fill in model spec, version, window, and at least one horizon.

train.title: Train model
train.summary: Train a candidate version from a frozen dataset.
train.predictionHorizonHelp: Frozen into the trained artifact and used online for horizon score multiplier and suggested_horizon_secs. Not a runtime-config field — set per training run (default 86400 = 24h).
train.incomplete: Fill in model spec, dataset, version, family, and label.
train.noPermission: You lack permission to train models (materialization:create).
train.modalUnavailable: The train form is not ready yet; try again in a moment.

backtest.title: Run backtest
backtest.summary: Replay the model over a frozen dataset (PIT only).
backtest.comparisonPlaceholder: Optional — select a baseline for pair mode
backtest.incomplete: Fill in the dataset and version.

publish.title: Publish model
publish.summaryWithWarnings: Promote model version {id} to Published. {count} soft gate warning(s) — review before confirming.
publish.blocked: Cannot publish: {count} hard gate(s) failing. Review the publish readiness scorecard.

rollback.title: Rollback model
rollback.summary: Restore retired model version {id} to Published.

detail.title: Trained Model

metricsPanel.empty: No trainer metrics for this version.

detail.noBacktests: No backtest reports for this version yet.

categoryPanel.empty: No per-category breakdown in this report.

expectedVsRealizedPanel.empty: No structured expected-vs-realized metrics in this report.

collinearity.title: Factor Collinearity
collinearity.hint: Pairwise Spearman rank correlation across recent factor values. Highly correlated factors carry redundant signal.
collinearity.empty: No factor values in the recent window to analyze.
collinearity.clean: No factor pair exceeds the correlation threshold.
collinearity.violationsTitle: {count} collinear factor pair(s) exceed the threshold

verdict.improved: Candidate improves on the baseline (rank IC and realized PnL).
verdict.regressed: Candidate regresses against the baseline (rank IC and realized PnL).
verdict.mixed: Mixed result — rank IC and realized PnL disagree on direction.

sideBySide.title: Baseline vs Candidate
sideBySide.empty: Absolute metrics unavailable — a backtest report could not be loaded.

categoryDiffPanel.empty: No per-category divergence in this comparison.

qualityGate.empty: Publish readiness has not been evaluated.

verdict.ready: Ready to publish — all hard gates cleared.

degradeReason.market_data_coverage_degraded: Market-data WebSocket shard coverage degraded (disconnected shards)

system.readonlyHint: Use the header state lights to change runtime mode or kill switch.

kpi.netLiqTip: Venue net liquidation from the latest live account read.
kpi.availableTip: Collateral available for sizing after reservations.
kpi.drawdownTip: Drawdown from the latest persisted equity snapshot high-water mark.
kpi.activeMarketsTip: Markets currently tracked by the runtime catalog.

recovery.title: Execution Recovery
recovery.loadFailed: Unable to load recovery status. Retry or check system access.
recovery.resolveHint: Resolve blocking reconciliations from the reconciliation queue; unblocking is credential-gated and never fabricated here.

killSwitch.title: Kill Switch
killSwitch.requiresAck: Kill switch is latched and requires operator acknowledgement.
killSwitch.ackSummary: This clears a latched state and requires acknowledgement.

block.summary: Block market "{question}" from selection and execution.

kpi.sumHint: Sum of YES and NO mid prices; a large deviation from 1.00 signals an arbitrage / consistency issue.
kpi.imbalanceHint: Top-5 share-weighted queue imbalance of the YES book; positive is bid-heavy (buy pressure).

approve.title: Approve Intent
approve.summary: Approve intent {id}. Leave overrides blank to approve the frozen spec verbatim.
approve.maxAllowedUsdHelp: Defensive notional ceiling re-checked by the backend.

reject.title: Reject Intent
reject.summary: Reject intent {id} and release its reserved capital.

cancel.title: Cancel Intent
cancel.summary: Cancel not-yet-submitted intent {id} and release its reserved capital.

submit.title: Submit Intent
submit.summary: Submit intent {id} to the venue. This signs and places a real order.

disabled.notSubmittable: The intent is not in a submittable state.
disabled.mode: report_only never submits (real-account sizing, not dry-run).
disabled.modeApprovalMismatch: The approval provenance does not match the runtime mode (operator vs policy).
disabled.killSwitch: The kill-switch is not closed; new entries are blocked.
disabled.recoveryBlocked: Auto-execution is blocked while reconciliation recovery holds the plane.
disabled.expired: The intent has passed its expiry deadline.
disabled.systemLoading: System status is still loading; wait before submitting.

detail.title: Order Intent
detail.loadError: Failed to load the order intent.

resolve.title: Resolve Reconciliation
resolve.summary: Resolve reconciliation {id} with an operator verdict.
resolve.filledSharesHelp: Observed venue fill (optional, for partial/filled verdicts).

run.title: Run Ad-hoc Report
run.summary: Enqueue an ad-hoc TopN report run. Leave overrides blank to use server defaults.
run.governedSummary: Enqueue an ad-hoc TopN recommendation report run.

actions.revokeSummary: Revoke published report {id}. This is irreversible and marks the report and its recommendations revoked.

diff.comparePlaceholder: Select a baseline report to compare against
diff.empty: No other published report of this kind to compare against.
diff.failed: Diff could not be computed for the selected baseline.

factors.indeterminateHint: This factor had no usable cross-section, so it produced no score and did not contribute (never a fabricated neutral).

evidence.title: Replay Handles
evidence.empty: Evidence is unavailable for this recommendation.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.pending: Attribution is written after the position is settled (post-trade labeling). It is read-only and appears here once available.

createIntent.title: Create Order Intent
createIntent.summary: Create an order intent from recommendation {id}. Entry order, sizing and risk envelope are frozen from this recommendation.

disabled.mode: Current runtime mode is report_only. This is not dry-run — intent creation is disabled until the operator switches to semi_auto or auto_execution.
disabled.killSwitch: The kill-switch is not closed; new entries are blocked.
disabled.eligibility: This recommendation is not eligible for execution in the current runtime mode.
disabled.riskEnvelope: The risk envelope is invalid (max position or max loss is not positive).
disabled.reportStatus: The parent report is no longer published.
disabled.recommendationStatus: This recommendation can no longer create an intent (revoked / expired / executed).
disabled.activeIntent: An order intent already exists for this recommendation.

editor.title: Edit Runtime Config
editor.advancedSummary: The full runtime-config document will replace the live config as a new version and be activated immediately. Review carefully.
editor.advancedHint: Advanced mode replaces the entire document. Prefer the form editor for scoped changes.
editor.noApplyAccess: Your role can read config only. Creating and activating versions requires runtime_config:create and runtime_config:activate.

feedback.applied: Runtime config version created and activated

diff.title: Diff Preview
diff.acknowledgeGovernanceCritical: I have reviewed the governance-critical changes above

switchSection.title: Unsaved changes
switchSection.content: "{section}" has unsaved changes. Switch section anyway? Your draft will be kept until you apply or reset.

reloadLiveConfig.title: Live config changed
reloadLiveConfig.content: The active runtime config was updated elsewhere. Reloading discards unsaved edits in this editor.
reloadLiveConfig.pending: A newer runtime config is active. Your unsaved edits are based on an older snapshot.

error.createdButNotActivated: The version was created but not activated. Open it below to activate or roll back.
error.confirmDiffRequired: Review and acknowledge governance-critical diffs before applying.
error.jsonObjectRequired: The runtime-config document must be a JSON object.

cadence.noPreview: No upcoming runs for this cadence.
